paragraphs: Rav Pappa son of Rav Aha bar Adda. In Rava bar Ulla's name, Eruvin 21b: the reading is ‘in Rav Aha bar Ulla's name.’ In Rava's name: Sanhedrin 29, beginning of b. R' Tanhum asked him, ‘Whence do you know this?’ He answered, ‘From my father and master; and my father and master heard it from Rav’ [אבא מרי, provisional sense]; Berakhot 29b.
